question: According to Table 4, by what factor did molecular distillation raise the α-terpineol percentage of the light fraction over the niaouli oil residue?
rendered: According to Table 4, the α-terpineol percentage in the niaouli oil residue (NOR) is 36.52%, while in the light fraction (LF) it is 66.10%. Therefore, molecular distillation raised the α-terpineol percentage of the light fraction over the niaouli oil residue by a factor of 66.10 / 36.52 ≈ 1.81.
